reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a speech bubble with text lines and an outward right-pointing arrow, universally understood as sending or forwarding a message or comment. Sending texts, replying to chats, and forwarding messages are among the most common everyday tasks across personal and work lists. It is fairly distinct from a plain chat bubble due to the directional arrow, though at tiny sizes the arrow could blend slightly with the bubble frame.
